full_judgment: 13. It appears that it is a judgment of reversal as the trial Court had convicted the accused-respondents, however, the High Court Division allowed the appeal and thereby acquitted both the appellants from the charge leveled against them. In view of the above, it is pertinent to this Division to examine the judgment of the High Court Division whether the same had been passed after appreciating the materials on record or not.
